mapping_json.motion_frame: stand-your-ground ramp caster: root in place and cast continuously to build Intensity (more damage, narrower beam); moving bleeds Intensity off — the anti-mobility damage-vs-AoE trade

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: ERA NOTE per batch instruction: era is 3.12-3.13 (errata_applied=1 in verify_ledger; canon_corpus already stamps 3.12-3.13; the stage-1 3.7-3.13 stamp was CONTRADICTED — skill debuted 3.12 Heist). Respected. beam_channel + lightning + sunder is the base identity and lands. THE APPROX driver — a COMPOUND that no single lane holds: Intensity is (a) a stand-still stacking ramp (max 3, +35% more damage/stack — a charge-stack accumulator, native) that (b) SIMULTANEOUSLY reshapes the geometry: +0.3m beam width AND 33% LESS branching angle per stack, so the beam morphs from wide-frontal-fan (0 stacks) to narrow-focused-lance (3 stacks). The engine can carry the DAMAGE ramp (accumulator) OR the beam geometry, but NOT 'the stack count continuously reshapes the beam's width and branching.' A Crackling Lance player would lose the signature feel of the beam TIGHTENING as they hold their ground — the AoE-vs-damage geometry trade IS the skill's identity, and it maps to no lane. Reset-on-move carried as a stationary-uptime persistent condition (proc-loop placeholder for the hold-to-maintain). No mint proposed: geometry-morph-driven-by-stacks is a qualitative mechanism (would need evidence-gating); flagged for steward as a candidate if it recurs. ELEMENTAL_ECHO for mono-lightning; TEMPORAL_CHARGE for the stack-engine capstone. Golem-stacking (Primordial Chain) is an external buff-multiplier variant, noted not core.

mints_anchored.description: Stack-parameterizes-geometry: an accumulator whose stack count reshapes the skill's LIVE geometry/emission, not just its damage. Three attested bindings: intensity-stacks narrow+intensify a beam (crackling-lance); stacks morph placed-AoE arc coverage (pizza-sticks); stored catch-count sets release projectile COUNT (venom-gyre). Engine accumulator scales magnitude only.

payload.geometry: Primary beam fires forward in a long trajectory, dealing lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front. Secondary branches angle outward from the primary beam catching enemies to the sides. At full Intensity (3 stacks): beam width +0.9m, branching angle compressed 99% — near-forward narrow beam. At zero Intensity: wide branching pattern covering broad frontal lane.

skill_geometry.anchor_quote: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle. 33% less branching angle per Intensity; +0.3 metres to Beam Width Per Intensity.

payload.loop: Stand still and cast Crackling Lance continuously. Each cast gains 1 Intensity stack (max 3). Intensity grants 35% more damage with hits and ailments per stack, and +0.3m beam width per stack, but also narrows branching angle by 33% per stack — damage concentrates forward as intensity rises. Lose 1 Intensity every 0.5s while moving, or immediately on teleport. Requires stationary positioning to maintain ramp.
